query:
UPDATE virustotal_file_scans AS scan
		SET status = 'completed',
			analysis_id = 'test-fixture-' || scan.file_id::text,
			analysis = $2,
			submitted_at = NOW(),
			checked_at = NOW(),
			updated_at = NOW()
		FROM files
		JOIN versions ON versions.id = files.version_id
		WHERE scan.file_id = files.id AND versions.mod_id = $1
